lines.trans: Chen, please tell me it was just a tiny bit of air in the pipe!
Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.
Will the rooms get cold tonight? And is there no hot water either?
Old brick walls hold heat, so the rooms stay warm until daybreak—don't worry.
Thank heavens! What about morning showers for the guests?
By tomorrow morning, the shower water will be ice-cold.
Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!
Is there a spare brass valve in your toolbox?
Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.
What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?
Seven sharp—half an hour earlier than breakfast.
Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋楼 ('a building').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: a. Expresses sudden realization at the start of a line, or softens warmth at the end.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng jù xiāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个工具箱 ('a toolbox').

examples.text: 工具箱里有备用的铜阀门吗？
examples.trans: Is there a spare brass valve in your toolbox?

examples.text: 付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
examples.trans: Paid in cash! Open your toolbox and wait—I am running back across the bridge!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi yòng. Describes a spare key, spare bulb, or backup plan.

examples.text: 工具箱里有备用的铜阀门吗？
examples.trans: Is there a spare brass valve in your toolbox?

examples.text: 两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
examples.trans: Buy both! Keeping a spare saves worry next winter too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōng tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个冬天 ('a winter').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。

meanings.note: Pinyin: diào. As a verb, 'drop'; after another verb, marks removal or disposal (关掉 'turn off', 擦掉 'wipe away').

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì hòu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最后一个 ('the last one').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí yǒu. Combines 只 ('only') with 有 ('have / there is').

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáo. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座桥 ('a bridge').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà biān. Points to a location or party on the other end.

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ jīn diàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家五金店 ('a hardware store').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。

examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǐ cun. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个尺寸 ('a size / measurement').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。

examples.text: 这两个铜阀门的尺寸完全一样。
examples.trans: The dimensions of these two brass valves are identical.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个家 ('a home').

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！
examples.trans: Look beside ours: Courtyard width, street noise, quiet score nine points!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐ. Asks about small numbers (几点 'what time', 几个 'how many') before a measure word.

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 那家五金店早上几点开门？
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.en: open the door; open for business
meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi mén. Means both opening a physical door and opening a shop for the day.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qī. Cardinal number 7; combines with 月 for July and 点 for seven o'clock.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng. Combines with a measure word to mean 'the entire' (整条街 'the whole street', 整栋楼 'the whole building').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ. Forms comparisons in A 比 B + adj ('A is more adj than B').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 听听他说的！老陈比我们好奇两倍！
examples.trans: Listen to him! Chen is twice as curious as we are!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo cān. Measure word (量词): 顿 (dùn), e.g. 一顿早餐 ('a breakfast').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo. Alone as a greeting, 早！ means a brisk, friendly 'Morning!'.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn. Follows a measure word for 'and a half' (七点半 '7:30') or precedes a measure word for 'half a' (半个小时).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo shí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个小时 ('an hour').

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

examples.text: 七点整——比早餐早半个小时。
examples.trans: Seven sharp—half an hour earlier than breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dìng. Used for setting a time or booking an appointment (定好 'settle/fix').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 我们已经定好了明天见面的时间。
examples.trans: We have already set the time to meet tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nào zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个闹钟 ('an alarm clock').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 为了赶早班火车，我定了六点的闹钟。
examples.trans: To catch the morning train, I set my alarm clock for six.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng zǎo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 明天早上 ('tomorrow morning').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 明早七点半我们在楼下咖啡馆见。
examples.trans: Let's meet downstairs in the café tomorrow morning at seven thirty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pǎo. Everyday verb for running.

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
examples.trans: Can you run there and back within ten minutes?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yíng. Opposite of 输; can serve as a result complement (跑赢 'outrun / win the race').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 弟弟今天下棋赢了哥哥一次。
examples.trans: The younger brother beat his older brother once at chess today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: léng shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯冷水 ('a glass of cold water').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!
